# Going Endo

> Going Endo brings emerging technology education into a company and helps its team test one real idea on a real problem. The name means "going within": we work inside your company instead of sending leaders away to a conference.

Going Endo LLC is an independent emerging technology education company based in Utah. It is preparing to launch and is inviting its first company partners.

## Who it serves

Leadership teams at companies with roughly 100 to 5,000 employees, plus the chambers, industry groups, and universities that support them. Going Endo works with companies across the United States, on site or online.

## How it works

1. Learn: experts teach your leadership team what AI and other emerging technologies mean for your industry.
2. Test: Going Endo works with your team for several weeks on one real problem in your operations.
3. Keep: you leave with a working pilot and measured results.

## How it starts

With a free briefing for your leadership team. If there is a good fit, Going Endo plans a short program and an applied project with you. Program pricing depends on scope and is shared after the briefing.
